provenance.dataset: FAFB (Full Adult Fly Brain), FlyWire connectome materialization
provenance.version_confidence: inferred from an incomplete download filename; not attested by the completed files
provenance.retrieval_source_note: No download log or source URL is stored with the files. Filenames indicate Princeton/FlyWire exports; confirm the release and DOI before publication.
provenance.scope: brain only (FAFB); no complete ventral nerve cord, so BANC or Male CNS is required for a complete brain-to-motor pathway

connections.table_grain: (pre_root_id, post_root_id, neuropil); syn_count is the number of synapses for that directed pair in that neuropil
connections.directed_evidence: pre_root_id -> post_root_id columns; reciprocal and one-way directed pairs coexist
connections.strength: syn_count (integer synapse count); pair strength is the sum of syn_count across neuropils
connections.filtered_rule: keep every row belonging to a directed neuron pair whose summed syn_count across all neuropils is >= 5

reciprocal.unfiltered_note: reciprocal fraction computed on the filtered table; directionality is identical in both tables

connections.hash_note: pair sets use a 64-bit mixed hash; at 22.3M rows the collision probability is negligible, and pair/row/synapse counts matched exactly

caveats: The filtered connectome is thresholded on summed pair strength (>=5 synapses), not on each neuropil row; do not apply a second per-row cutoff.
Coordinates contain multiple rows per neuron and exact duplicate rows; deduplicate exact rows before aggregating positions.
Neurotransmitter type is missing for part of the neuron table.
Some neurons have no connection rows and are still valid nodes; keep them in the graph.
Synapse attachment rates use 81 neuropil labels including three aggregate rows; the connection table uses 79 neuropil labels.
FAFB is brain-only; motor output to the full nerve cord is out of scope for these files.
